HELP.TITLE: Help
HELP.SUBTITLE: Find quick answers about Relevo or replay the initial walkthrough.
HELP.FAQ_1_A: Relevo connects owners who want to sell a business with people interested in buying or exploring real opportunities.
HELP.FAQ_2_Q: Can I view offers without signing up?
HELP.FAQ_2_A: Yes. You can explore offers and basic filters. To save favorites, use full search, request an offer or publish a business, you need to sign in.
HELP.FAQ_3_Q: How do I contact an offer owner?
HELP.FAQ_3_A: Open the offer, send a request and, when the owner accepts it, the chat between both parties becomes available inside the platform.
HELP.FAQ_4_Q: What happens when a sale is marked as closed?
HELP.FAQ_4_A: When both owner and interested user confirm the closed sale, the match inside Relevo is considered completed and both can rate the experience.
HELP.FAQ_5_A: From the bell you can create alerts by city, size or revenue. If a matching offer appears, you receive a notification and it is saved in the alert history.

mentoring.title: Guidance & Mentoring
mentoring.subtitle: Learn the best practices to sell your company or buy one successfully.
mentoring.no_modules: No mentoring modules are active at this moment.

m1.title: Preparing the company for sale
m1.description: Learn to identify the best time to sell, understand the common reasons for selling, and avoid frequent mistakes before publishing the offer.

m2.title: Organizing the documentation
m2.description: Prepare the financial, legal, and operational documentation necessary to build trust with potential buyers.

m3.title: Valuing the company
m3.description: Understand what factors determine a company's value, such as profitability, assets, and growth potential.

m4.title: Creating an attractive offer
m4.description: Learn to present the business professionally, highlighting strengths while protecting confidential information.

m5.title: Managing contacts and negotiations
m5.description: Filter potential buyers, share information progressively, and manage negotiations professionally.

m6.title: Closing the sale
m6.description: Complete the final stages of the process, including Due Diligence, signing contracts, and preparing for the transition.

m1.title: Defining purchase objectives
m1.description: Determine the budget, sectors of interest, and key characteristics that the ideal company should have.

m2.title: Searching for opportunities
m2.description: Learn where to find companies for sale and how to perform an initial screening of potential opportunities.

m3.title: Analyzing the financial situation
m3.description: Interpret the financial information of the company, including revenue, profits, debt, and liquidity.

m4.title: Assessing if the price is right
m4.description: Analyze whether the valuation proposed by the seller is consistent with the reality and potential of the business.

m5.title: Negotiating the purchase
m5.description: Prepare to negotiate the price and conditions of the transaction, identifying risks and opportunities.

m6.title: Formalizing the acquisition
m6.description: Review legal documentation, complete Due Diligence, and formalize the purchase through the corresponding contracts.

m7.title: Managing the company
m7.description: Plan the transition, maintain the trust of the team and clients, and lay the foundations for future business growth.
